sources.snippet: MiniCPM-V 4.7 is the latest model in the MiniCPM-V series, available in a 35B-A3B variant, with 35B-A3B being the first MoE model in the MiniCPM-V series. It builds on the family's single-image, multi-image, and video understanding capabilities, combining stronger foundation capabilities with efficient visual encoding and on-device inference.

sources.title: ModelBest and OpenBMB Launch MiniCPM-V 4.7, Bringing a 35B Multimodal ...
sources.snippet: ModelBest describes MiniCPM-V 4.7 35B-A3B as the first open-source MoE multimodal model built to run smoothly on-device without compromising model quality.

sources.title: MiniCPM V 4.7 35B A3B | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: MiniCPM-V 4.7 35B-A3B is OpenBMB's open-source Mixture-of-Experts multimodal model for single-image, multi-image, and video understanding, and the first MoE model in the MiniCPM-V series. It targets on-device deployment, and OpenBMB reports a higher overall score than Qwen3.6 35B-A3B in Instruct mode with less inference time.
